patterns.note: Full-bleed sections are used, often with a single, massive typographic element or a minimal content block centered within the viewport.

Extremely oversized, decorative serif typography is used as primary visual elements, often filling the screen and acting as graphic anchors, contrasted with small, clean sans-serif for functional text.
A high-contrast palette of vibrant blue, white, and dark grey/black is used, with blue often dominating full sections or large text elements.
Massive, decorative text elements are revealed and animated on scroll, often scaling up or sliding into view to dominate the screen, creating a dynamic visual rhythm.
The 'Selected work' section uses a minimalist list layout where each work item is represented by a small sans-serif label and a large serif title, acting as a clickable link.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text legibility, paired with a large, expressive headline.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by GSAP and Locomotive Scroll, are used to reveal and animate massive typographic elements. These elements often scale, slide, or parallax into the viewport, creating a dramatic visual impact as the user scrolls.

The navigation bar is sticky and dynamically changes its appearance: initially white text on a dark hero, it transitions to white text on a white background as it scrolls past the hero, making it blend subtly with the page content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, decorative serif headings (~5-10x body text) are used as primary visual elements, contrasted with small, clean sans-serif for body and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, the cookie banner, and graphic elements like the 'ticket' shape, maintaining a generally soft but not overly rounded character.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and around large typographic elements, creating a sense of spaciousness and visual breathing room.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its audacious use of extremely oversized, decorative serif typography as primary visual elements. These massive text blocks are not merely headlines but animated, full-screen graphic elements that define the page's visual rhythm and create a memorable, almost art-like scroll experience.
